cfg.header:
FileRelay settings file (JSONC: JSON with comments)

· Using the Settings window ([File] > [Settings]) is recommended. You may also edit this file;
  a running FileRelay reloads it automatically when saved (port changes apply immediately).
· Escape backslashes in paths:  "D:\\Share"   (or "D:/Share")
· Saving from the Settings window rewrites this file with these comments (your own comments are lost).
· Theme, font and language changes take effect after a restart.

[Share access levels]
  none  : No access (the share is hidden from that peer)
  read  : Read only — browse, download
  write : Read & write — + upload (new files), new folders. No delete/overwrite/rename ("copy in only")
  full  : Full control — + delete (to my Recycle Bin), rename, overwrite
cfg.c.shares:
name        : Share name shown to peers (must be unique)
path        : Actual folder path on this PC
access      : Default access (none | read | write | full)
peerAccess  : Per-peer access. Key = peer name, IP or ID.  e.g. { "Alice": "full", "192.168.0.15": "none" }
enabled     : false = temporarily stop sharing
cfg.p.userName: Your name as shown to peers (required)
cfg.p.port: HTTP server port (TCP) and peer discovery port (UDP). Easiest if all peers use the same port
cfg.p.networkKey: (Optional) group key — only PCs with the same key can connect. Empty = anyone
cfg.p.autoAcceptPeers: When someone adds me, add them back automatically (false: ask first)
cfg.p.discoverable: Show this PC in [Find on network]
cfg.p.bootstrapPeers: Addresses to add automatically at startup. e.g. ["192.168.0.10", "pc-alice:45200"]
cfg.p.shareHiddenFiles: Also show hidden/system files to peers
cfg.p.remoteDeleteToRecycleBin: Files deleted by peers go to my Recycle Bin (recoverable)
cfg.p.serveSpeedLimitKBps: Speed limit when peers download from this PC (KB/s, 0 = unlimited)
cfg.p.downloadFolder: Start folder of the local pane (empty = Downloads)
cfg.p.maxConcurrentTransfers: Files transferred at the same time (1 - 8)
cfg.p.retryCount: Automatic retries on network errors (resumes where it stopped)
cfg.p.defaultConflictAction: When a file with the same name exists: ask | overwrite | overwriteIfNewer | overwriteIfDifferentSize | resume | rename | skip
cfg.p.preserveTimestamps: Keep the original modified time on transferred files
cfg.p.tempFolder: Temp folder for opening remote files (empty = %TEMP%\FileRelay)
cfg.p.notifyTransferComplete: Notify when transfers finish while the window is inactive
cfg.p.notePopup: Show incoming notes on screen right away (false: tray notification only)
cfg.p.noteSound: Play a sound for incoming notes
cfg.p.noteStyle: Note window style: auto (follow theme) | pastel | dark
cfg.p.noteColor: Default color for notes you send: yellow | green | pink | purple | blue | gray | charcoal
cfg.p.noteTopMost: Keep received notes on top (toggle per note with the pin button)
cfg.p.sendReadReceipt: Send a read receipt when I read a note
cfg.p.notifyPeerOnline: Notify when a peer comes online
cfg.p.notifyRemoteActivity: Notify when peers upload, delete or rename in my shares
cfg.p.autoAwayMinutes: Minutes of inactivity before switching to Away (0 = off)
cfg.p.startMinimized: Start in the tray without opening the window
cfg.p.startWithWindows: Start automatically when I sign in to Windows
cfg.p.confirmOnExit: Confirm [Exit] from the menu/tray (closing the window (X) always asks: keep in tray or quit)
cfg.p.showHiddenFiles: Show hidden files in the local pane
cfg.p.language: Display language: auto (Windows language) | ko | en (restart required)
cfg.p.uiFont: UI font: auto (Korean: Malgun Gothic, English: Segoe UI) or a font name (restart required)
